name: alipe3d-manager
description: Alipe3D Manager — gestão operacional, comercial e financeira para produção 3D.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @alipe3d/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @alipe3d/shared" "npm run dev -w @alipe3d/backend" "npm run dev -w @alipe3d/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @alipe3d/shared && npm run build -w @alipe3d/backend && npm run build -w @alipe3d/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @alipe3d/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @alipe3d/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:int: npm run build -w @alipe3d/shared && npm run test:int -w @alipe3d/backend
